theorem.name: SelectedUniversalHeteroticAxionReductionTheorem
theorem.statement: On the selected compact oriented heterotic X6, the integral of the dual B6 field over the fundamental six-cycle emits one periodic model-independent axion. Its kinetic normalization and universal gauge coupling follow from the same ten-dimensional B-field action; the flat order-three internal gerbe is a separate discrete class and is not used as this continuous mode.
